description: This file contains implementation related to tracing and logging for UCC-based process groups in PyTorch's distributed module. It includes functions for initializing tracers, flushing communication traces to files, and recording communication events with detailed metadata.

classes.name: ProcessGroupUCCLogger
classes.description: Handles initialization and flushing of communication tracers for UCC process groups.

classes.name: CommTraceLogger
classes.description: Responsible for recording communication events and maintaining trace information.

methods.name: void initCommsTracer()
methods.description: Initializes the communication tracer by creating a new trace logger instance.

methods.name: void flushComms(int rank,int world_size)
methods.description: Flushes the collected communication trace data to a JSON file, creating directory structure based on time and environment variables.

methods.name: void setCurBlock(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Unused method intended for adding a block name to the current trace.

methods.name: void popBlock()
methods.description: Unused method intended for removing the last added block from the trace.

methods.name: void recordOptionalInfo(const std::vector<int64_t> & outputSplitSizes,const std::vector<int64_t> & inputSplitSizes)
methods.description: Records optional information such as root rank or tensor split sizes.

methods.name: void recordComms(const std::string & commName,const uintptr_t workReq,const int rank,const int world_size,const std::vector<at::Tensor> & inputTensors,const std::vector<at::Tensor> & outputTensors)
methods.description: Records a communication event with detailed metadata such as message size, datatype, device, and timestamps.
